changes.before_fragment: Add induction reported for E. coli B is not transferred to K-12;
changes.after_fragment: Historical Add induction reported for E. coli B remains strain-specific. Independent MG1655 experiments measured adenine-induced add transcription (17.61-fold under the cited M9 glucose conditions), without establishing direct PurR regulation;

appended.subject: CHEBI:16708
appended.description: Measured transcript-level induction in wild-type E. coli K-12 MG1655: 17.61-fold after adenine supplementation (100 micrograms/mL) in M9 with 2 g/L glucose, at 37 C with agitation and sampled at mid-log phase. This is gene-expression context, not direct activation of Add protein or evidence of direct PurR regulation.

evidence.source_assertion: In wild-type E. coli K-12 MG1655 grown to mid-log phase at 37 C in M9 with 2 g/L glucose, 100 micrograms/mL adenine increased add transcript 17.61-fold. The study explicitly excludes add from direct PurR regulation.

evidence.source_assertion: The issuing Gene original identifies MG1655 add, locus b1623, taxon511145, and directly links its protein product to UniProtKB P22333.
